title: KillAllMobs
description: An exciting challenge where players must kill every mob – perfect for SMPs, challenges, and community servers.
body:
# KillAllMobsV4

KillAllMobsV4 brings an exciting and challenging mob challenge to your Minecraft server!

The goal of the challenge is simple:
Kill every available mob in Minecraft and complete the entire list.

Perfect for SMPs, challenge projects, YouTube videos, or community events. The plugin motivates players to explore the entire Minecraft world and face every creature.

## Features

* Complete mob challenge
* Progression system
* Live progress display
* Scoreboard system
* Support for all Minecraft mobs
* Fully configurable
* Performance optimized
* No watermarks
* Customizable messages and settings
* Modern and clean design
* Stable and efficient code

## Gameplay

Players must gradually kill every existing Minecraft mob.

Once a new mob has been defeated:

* the progress is saved
* the scoreboard updates
* the player gets closer to completing the full challenge

## Why KillAllMobsV4?

* Perfect for SMPs and challenges
* Encourages exploration and adventure
* High replay value
* Modern gameplay
* Lightweight and performant
* Optimized for modern Minecraft versions

## Use Cases

* SMP challenges
* Hardcore projects
* Community events
* YouTube formats
* Survival challenges
* Adventure servers
